verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs explicitly list first-party setup guides for 22 tools including LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and Vercel AI SDK, plus an MCP server, CLI, and OSS SDK verified live via runtime probes. This directly matches the story of dropping the memory layer into named agent frameworks via documented integrations. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of the LangChain/LangGraph/CrewAI/Vercel integration guides specifically working end-to-end (only the top-level docs.mem0.ai listing is cited, not per-framework docs content).
